cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the country is live on PAPSS: a regional payment system, or joining PAPSS, does not count.
cells.note: The CBL runs the LYPay and OnePay instant payment services and directed banks to activate LYPay in March 2026. No regional link has been found. The Central Bank of Libya joined PAPSS in December 2025 (LBY-005), but no live participation by a Libyan bank has been found, and accession alone is not counted.
